entities.summary: Şevket Pamuk is retired professor of Economics and Economic History at Boğaziçi University and author of prize-winning books and articles. Between 2007 and 2013, Pamuk was chair of Contemporary Turkish Studies at the European Institute, London School of Economics and Political Science.
